question: Among the top 10 tenant/VIF type combinations with the highest number of administratively-up ports (restricted to those where the administratively-up port windowed average standard attribute ID is greater than 0), display the tenant ID, VIF type, the number of distinct administratively-up ports, the number of distinct DOWN ports that have allocated IP addresses, and whether the tenant/VIF type has any DOWN ports with IPs. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH admin_up_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.tenant_id,
    b.vif_type,
    p.id AS port_id,
    AVG(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON p.id = b.port_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
),
filtered_ports AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, vif_type, port_id
  FROM admin_up_ports
  WHERE window_avg > 0
),
port_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tenant_id,
    vif_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS admin_up_port_count
  FROM filtered_ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id, vif_type
),
top_combos AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, vif_type, admin_up_port_count
  FROM port_counts
  ORDER BY admin_up_port_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
down_ports_with_ip AS (
  SELECT 
    p.tenant_id,
    b.vif_type,
    p.id AS port_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON p.id = b.port_id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
)
SELECT 
  tc.tenant_id,
  tc.vif_type,
  tc.admin_up_port_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dpi.port_id) AS down_port_with_ip_count,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dpi.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_down_ports_with_ips

LEFT JOIN down_ports_with_ip dpi ON tc.tenant_id = dpi.tenant_id AND tc.vif_type = dpi.vif_type
GROUP BY tc.tenant_id, tc.vif_type, tc.admin_up_port_count
ORDER BY tc.admin_up_port_count DESC
